tools.name: alerts
tools.description: Manage Kite price alerts - create, modify, delete, and retrieve alerts with optional history

mode.description: Operation mode: get=retrieve alerts, create=new alert, modify=update alert, delete=remove alerts

uuids.description: Array of alert UUIDs (for get/modify/delete modes). Exactly one UUID for modify; multiple UUIDs for get/delete

status.description: Filter alerts by status (only for get mode)

type.description: Filter alerts by type (only for get mode)

history.description: Include alert history (only for get mode, default: false)

alert_type.description: Alert type: simple or ato (required for create/modify modes)

lhs_exchange.description: Exchange for left-hand side instrument (required for create/modify modes)

lhs_tradingsymbol.description: Trading symbol for left-hand side instrument (required for create/modify modes)

lhs_attribute.description: Attribute for left-hand side (e.g., LastTradedPrice) (required for create/modify modes)

rhs_type.description: Right-hand side type: constant or instrument (required for create/modify modes)

rhs_constant.description: Constant value for right-hand side (required if rhs_type=constant)

rhs_exchange.description: Exchange for right-hand side instrument (required if rhs_type=instrument)

rhs_tradingsymbol.description: Trading symbol for right-hand side instrument (required if rhs_type=instrument)

rhs_attribute.description: Attribute for right-hand side (required if rhs_type=instrument)

basket.description: JSON string containing basket configuration. Required when alert_type=ato

tools.name: gtt
tools.description: List mode returns data/pagination with default limit 100 and maximum 500. Manage GTT (Good Till Triggered) orders that persist across trading sessions and execute when a price condition is met. Use mode=list to see all GTTs, mode=place to create a new GTT (single-leg or two-leg OCO), mode=modify to update an existing GTT, mode=delete to remove a GTT. To show a read-only interactive GTT monitor with trigger distances, use open_kite_view when available with view=gtt. Continue to use gtt directly for mutations.

mode.description: Operation mode: list=all GTT orders, place=create new GTT, modify=update existing GTT, delete=remove a GTT

trigger_id.description: GTT trigger ID (required for modify and delete modes)

exchange.description: Exchange (required for place and modify modes)

tradingsymbol.description: Trading symbol (required for place and modify modes)

last_price.description: Current price of the instrument (required for place and modify modes)

transaction_type.description: BUY or SELL (required for place and modify modes)

trigger_type.description: GTT trigger type (required for place and modify modes): single=one trigger, two-leg=OCO (one-cancels-other) with upper and lower triggers

limit_price.description: Limit price for the resulting order (for single-leg GTT)

upper_quantity.description: Quantity for the upper leg (for two-leg GTT)

upper_limit_price.description: Limit price for the upper leg (for two-leg GTT)

lower_quantity.description: Quantity for the lower leg (for two-leg GTT)

lower_limit_price.description: Limit price for the lower leg (for two-leg GTT)

from.description: Starting index for pagination (0-based). Applies to list mode. Default: 0

limit.description: Page size (integer 1-500, default 100). Responses always include pagination metadata

outputSchema.description: Paginated GTT list or mutation result with trigger_id.

tools.name: help
tools.description: Browse Kite workflows and recipes as a tree. Start with key=/, then /client-integration, /orders, /holdings, /technical-analysis, /daily-review, or /troubleshooting. Follow child keys for focused recipes. Reads bundled Markdown only; does not execute trades or fetch account data.

key.description: Exact help path (maximum 1024 UTF-8 bytes), e.g. /orders/reconcile. Omit for the root index.

tools.name: market
tools.description: Retrieve market data and search instruments. Use mode=option_chain with underlying and optional exchange/expiry to discover a complete indexed option chain, paginated by strike with expiries, spot and future references; fetch quotes separately. Use mode=quote for full market snapshots (OHLC, volume, bid/ask depth, OI) for up to 500 instruments, mode=ltp for last traded price only (lighter), mode=ohlc for today's OHLC, mode=historical for historical candle data, mode=search to find instruments by name, symbol, ISIN, or token across all exchanges. Search returns data/pagination/meta, sorted with exact symbol matches first, then by ID and token, with default limit 100 and maximum 500. Quote/LTP/OHLC return data/meta with missing_instruments; entirely unresolved requests return an error. Search results come from the BOD instrument master by default; set include_live_quote=true to enrich returned results with live quote fields and quote_timestamp. For an interactive option chain, quote, historical chart, or instrument finder, use open_kite_view when available with view=option_chain, quote, historical, or search.

_app_request_id.description: Optional opaque correlation ID supplied by the embedded explorer. Other callers should omit it.

mode.description: Operation mode: quote=full market data snapshot (OHLC, depth, OI), ltp=last traded price only, ohlc=today's open/high/low/close, historical=historical OHLC candles, search=search instrument master list, option_chain=complete indexed option chain by underlying and expiry

instruments.description: List of instruments in exchange:tradingsymbol format, e.g. ['NSE:INFY', 'NSE:SBIN']. Required for quote, ltp, ohlc modes. Up to 500 instruments per call.

instrument_token.description: Numeric instrument token (required for historical mode). Use search mode to find this.

from_date.description: Start date in IST: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS or YYYY-MM-DD (start of day; required for historical mode)

to_date.description: End date in IST: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS or YYYY-MM-DD (end of day; required for historical mode)

continuous.description: Stitch futures contracts into a continuous series (historical mode only)

oi.description: Include open interest data (historical mode only)

search_mode.description: Search lookup mode (only for mode=search): search=text search, get_by_id=exact ID, get_by_tradingsymbol=exchange+symbol, get_by_isin=ISIN, get_by_inst_token=instrument token, get_by_exch_token=exchange token

verbosity.description: Response verbosity for search mode: compact=essential fields (recommended), full=all instrument details

query.description: Search text (required for mode=search with search_mode=search)

filter_on.description: Field to search on (for search_mode=search): id=exchange:tradingsymbol, name=instrument name, isin=ISIN, tradingsymbol=symbol only, underlying=F&O underlying (query format: exch:underlying, e.g. NFO:NIFTY)

id.description: Instrument ID in EXCHANGE:TRADINGSYMBOL format (for search_mode=get_by_id)

exchange.description: Exchange code for exact search; option_chain supports NFO/NSE or BFO/BSE, default NFO

underlying.description: Option-chain underlying name or symbol, e.g. NIFTY, NIFTY 50, BANKNIFTY, RELIANCE, SENSEX. Required for option_chain.

expiry.description: Option-chain expiry YYYY-MM-DD; omitted selects nearest valid unexpired expiry.

snapshot.description: Option-chain catalog_revision returned on the first page; send on subsequent pages to reject mixed catalog revisions.

from.description: Starting index for pagination (0-based). Applies to search results or option_chain strike rows. Default: 0

limit.description: Page size (integer 1-500, default 100). Responses always include pagination metadata

include_live_quote.description: For mode=search, optionally enrich returned results with live quote fields like last_price and circuit limits using the quote endpoint

tools.name: mutual_funds
tools.description: Retrieve mutual fund data from Coin (Zerodha's mutual fund platform). Use mode=holdings to get all mutual fund holdings.

mode.description: Operation mode: holdings=mutual fund holdings via Coin

tools.name: orders
tools.description: Manage orders. Placement, modification, and cancellation require user approval. Clients with form elicitation show a form. Other clients receive a browser approval link automatically. The user signs in to the matching Kite account and confirms the order in any browser; no original-browser requirement. For ChatGPT mobile or a client known not to display forms, set approval_method=browser on the initial call. If future_orders_allowed=true, use auto unless the user explicitly requests another review. Do not ask the user to request a link; share the returned approval_url immediately and do not open or approve it on their behalf. Native failures reported to the server fall back to browser review when possible; explicit decline, cancellation, and negative confirmation stop the request. An approval_required result means no order was submitted: do not repeat the order call. Use approval_status with its approval_id to check the outcome. A status of approved_for_later means approval was saved for this exact order once, but nothing was placed. Wait for a new user instruction before making the matching order request with approval_method=auto. Changed order details require new approval unless future_orders_allowed=true. Saving an exact-order approval does not revoke existing permission for any future order. Users can explicitly allow future orders for this client from the browser approval page. Use permissions to show or manage this permission. Use mode=list to see all orders today, mode=history for an order's status trail, mode=trades for fills on a specific order, mode=all_trades for all trades today, mode=place to place a new order, mode=modify to change an open order, mode=cancel to cancel an open order. List and all_trades modes return data/pagination with default limit 100 and maximum 500. To show a read-only interactive order book with timeline and fills, use open_kite_view when available with view=orders. Only request mutations when the user asks for the action. Approval observations include approval_method_used, approval_outcome, fallback_reason, native_elicitation_attempted, and native_elicitation_completed. Approval is not evidence of successful submission. After approval_status, inspect both status and the nested submission result; failed or declined is not a successful submission. Do not poll indefinitely. Continue to use orders directly for transaction requests.

mode.description: Operation mode: list=all orders today, history=status trail for an order, trades=fills for an order, all_trades=all trades today, place=place new order, modify=modify open order, cancel=cancel open order, approval_status=check a browser approval outcome, permissions=manage future order permission

approval_method.description: Select browser automatically for ChatGPT mobile or clients known not to display approval forms. auto uses client capabilities. Do not ask the user to request a link. This never grants approval.

approval_id.description: Browser approval ID (required for approval_status). Check this rather than repeating a pending order request.

order_id.description: Order ID (required for history, trades, modify, cancel modes)

variety.description: Order variety (required for place, modify, cancel modes)

transaction_type.description: BUY or SELL (required for place mode)

quantity.description: Quantity in units, not lots (required for place mode); multiply lots by the instrument lot size

product.description: Product type (required for place mode): CNC=delivery, MIS=intraday, NRML=F&O overnight, MTF=margin funding

order_type.description: Order type (required for place and modify modes): MARKET, LIMIT, SL (stop-loss limit), SL-M (stop-loss market)

price.description: Limit price for LIMIT/SL placement; supply it when changing the price in modify mode

trigger_price.description: Trigger price for SL/SL-M placement; supply it when changing the trigger in modify mode

validity.description: Order validity: DAY, IOC (immediate or cancel), TTL (time-to-live in minutes)

validity_ttl.description: Order life span in minutes (required when validity=TTL)

iceberg_legs.description: Number of legs for iceberg orders

iceberg_quantity.description: Quantity per leg for iceberg orders

market_protection.description: Market protection percentage for MARKET and SL-M orders. 0=disabled, 1-100=custom %, -1=auto

autoslice.description: Auto-split large orders exceeding freeze quantity limits into smaller child orders (max 50 slices)

from.description: Starting index for pagination (0-based). Applies to list and all_trades modes. Default: 0

limit.description: Page size (integer 1-500, default 100). Responses always include pagination metadata

outputSchema.description: Paginated orders, wrapped history/fill lists, an order submission result, browser approval state, or client permissions. Approval state is not evidence of submission.

tools.name: portfolio
tools.description: Retrieve portfolio and account information. Use mode=profile for user details (name, email, account type), mode=margins for available funds and margins, mode=holdings for demat holdings with P&L, mode=positions for open intraday and overnight positions. Position rows include view=day for today's activity or view=net for current exposure; do not sum the two views. Full/compact holdings and positions return data/pagination with default limit 100 and maximum 500. Summary holdings are unpaginated. For visual holdings allocation, position P&L, or funds views, use open_kite_view when available with view=holdings, positions, or funds.

_app_request_id.description: Optional opaque correlation ID supplied by the embedded explorer. Other callers should omit it.

mode.description: Operation mode: profile=user profile and account details, margins=available funds and margins across segments, holdings=demat holdings with P&L, positions=open intraday and overnight positions

type.description: Holdings data type (only for mode=holdings). 'full' returns detailed holdings, 'summary' returns aggregated data, 'compact' returns minimal fields

from.description: Starting index for pagination (0-based). Applies to holdings (full/compact) and positions modes. Default: 0

limit.description: Page size (integer 1-500, default 100). Responses always include pagination metadata

outputSchema.description: Mode-specific account object. Bare upstream lists or null are wrapped in data; existing object fields are preserved.

tools.name: session
tools.description: Inspect or invalidate the current authenticated session. Use mode=status to check session state and mode=logout to invalidate the current session.

mode.description: Operation mode: status=current session state, logout=invalidate current session
